sentences.en: their products.

sentences.en: Laura Spiteri Cornish is a marketing and advertising professor at Coventry
sentences.zh: 劳拉·斯皮泰里·科尼什（Laura Spiteri Cornish）是英国考文垂大学的营销与广告学教授。

sentences.en: University in the United Kingdom.

sentences.en: She studies how foods are marketed to consumers and how that affects our decisions about what to eat.

sentences.en: Welcome, Dr. Spiteri Cornish.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴来到这里。

sentences.en: I'm very happy to be here.
sentences.zh: 首先，什么是功能性食品？

sentences.en: First of all, what is a functional food?
sentences.zh: 好的，功能性食品基本上就是任何以某种方式进行过强化的食品。

sentences.en: Okay, so a functional food basically is any food that has been fortified in some way.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他们在食品中添加了超出其本身含量的维生素或矿物质。

sentences.en: Now, what that means is they have added vitamins or minerals to a food over and above of what it actually is.
sentences.zh: 这非常、非常普遍。

sentences.en: It's very, very common.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你吃玉米片，它基本上是强化了维生素A，那它实际上就是一种功能性食品。

sentences.en: So if you have cornflakes and it's basically fortified with vitamin A, that is actually a functional food.
sentences.zh: 或者如果你吃面包，面包上说它强化了欧米伽-3，那它也是一种功能性食品。

sentences.en: Or if you have bread and in the bread they say it's fortified with omega-3, that is also a functional food.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在超市的货架上随处可见。

sentences.en: So we find them everywhere on the shelves in our supermarkets.
sentences.zh: 你会说功能性食品实际上更多是一种营销工具吗？

sentences.en: Would you say that functional foods are actually more of a marketing tool?
sentences.zh: 它们是否会基于这些食品的强化作用而影响人们的饮食决定？

sentences.en: Do they influence what people decide to eat based on the fortification of these foods?
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 我想让你退后一步，其实大多数食品都是营销工具。

sentences.en: I want to just take you a step back and say that actually most foods are marketing tools.
sentences.zh: 自从工业化发生、食品开始加工以来，营销人员就对我们的口味、我们对食物的渴望进行了大量研究。

sentences.en: So ever since industrialization has happened and foods have been processed, marketers have done a lot of research into our taste, into our desires of food.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，他们使用了很多流程来提供我们真正喜爱的食物。

sentences.en: So, you know, they use a lot of processes to give us the foods we actually love.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么有时我们停不下来。

sentences.en: That's why sometimes we can't stop eating.
sentences.zh: 而且最重要的是，他们让这些食物变得越来越方便。

sentences.en: And on top of that, they make them more and more convenient.
sentences.zh: 现在，功能性食品的出现基本上是因为他们注意到消费者越来越关注健康。

sentences.en: Now, functional foods basically have arrived as a result of the fact that they notice that consumers have paid more and more attention to health.
sentences.zh: 以及这种健康与食物有关的认知。

sentences.en: And this understanding that health is related to food.
sentences.zh: 所以营销人员立即抓住了这一点，决定说我们要提供那些也能提供一些健康益处的食品。

sentences.en: So marketers have immediately jumped on this and decided to say we are going to offer foods that are actually also going to offer some health benefits.
sentences.zh: 因此，在这种情况下，功能性食品是一个非常、非常强大的营销工具，因为

sentences.en: So functional foods in that case are a very, very powerful marketing tool because
sentences.zh: 营销人员利用它们来告诉人们，看，你很害怕，你知道，如果你吃错了食物可能会生病。

sentences.en: marketers use them to offer people, look, you are afraid, you know, you might get sick if you eat the wrong food.

sentences.en: So buy these foods and these foods will actually give you all the nutrients you need and they will actually make you healthy.
sentences.zh: 而人们确实相信这一点。

sentences.en: So yes, they are very, very powerful marketing tool.

sentences.zh: 它们对你有好处吗？

sentences.en: Well, there are two types of functional foods and I've done some research about this and I've asked a lot of people about how they consume functional foods.

sentences.en: But if you look at the amount of sugar that there is in the cereal, it makes it very, very unhealthy.
sentences.zh: 有一些好的，但我认为80%的功能性食品，它们并不像人们想象的那么健康。

sentences.en: There are some good, but I think there's 80% of functional foods, they're not really as healthy as people think.
sentences.zh: 那么这些食品什么时候对你有好处呢？

sentences.en: So when can these foods be good for you?
sentences.zh: 所以查看标签很重要，因为即使是营养贫乏的功能性食品，

sentences.en: So it's important to look at the labels, because even the nutritionally poor functional foods,
sentences.zh: 你知道，有时它们还可以，因为它们确实含有营养，它们有维生素，它们有矿物质，它们有纤维。

sentences.en: you know, sometimes they're okay, because they do have nutrients, they have vitamins, they have minerals, they have fiber.

sentences.en: But what is really important is you can't use these foods instead of something a lot healthier.
sentences.zh: 所以我在研究中发现，我有很多非常不喜欢水果和蔬菜的人，但他们意识到自己缺乏

sentences.en: So what I found in my research is I have a lot of people who really don't like fruits and really don't like vegetables, but they're aware that they're missing
sentences.zh: 纤维、矿物质和维生素。

sentences.en: out on fiber and minerals and vitamins.
sentences.zh: 所以他们中的许多人，奇怪的是，他们没有去买水果和蔬菜，而是买了功能性食品，因为他们认为他们会从那里得到纤维

sentences.en: So many of them, strangely enough, instead of buying the fruits and vegetables, they buy functional foods because they think they'll get the fiber from there

sentences.en: or the vitamins from there.
sentences.zh: 但现实是人们需要明白，营养来源和营养本身一样重要。

sentences.en: The fiber you get from a chocolatey cereal bar is not the same as the fiber you get from broccoli or any other fruit and vegetable.

sentences.en: So yes, it's okay if overall, you know, you have a nice good diet full of fruits and vegetables and lean meats,
sentences.zh: 并且你添加了一根谷物棒或强化谷物，那是可以的，但你不能用它来替代，你知道，真正好的、健康的食物，如水果、蔬菜和全谷物。

sentences.en: and you add a cereal bar or a fortified cereal, but you can't use it to substitute, you know, really good, healthy foods like fruits and vegetables and whole grains.

sentences.en: I mean, we work really hard, we have long hours.

sentences.en: And the reality is you have to make sacrifices and you know, you have to make sure that you make the right decisions and that usually requires work and effort.

sentences.zh: 这是一个非常、非常大的生意。

sentences.zh: 我在两个不同的方面发现了很多。

sentences.en: Right.

sentences.zh: 并试图确保你调节你的情绪。
